facts.text: Index: National Annual Report and Index on Women's Safety (NARI) 2025 — perception survey of 12,770 women in 31 cities
facts.head: News

facts.text: By: conceived by Pvalue Analytics, The NorthCap University, Jindal Global Law School; published by Group of Intellectuals and Academicians (GIA); supported by NCW
facts.head: News

facts.text: Safest cities: Kohima, Visakhapatnam, Bhubaneswar, Aizawl, Gangtok, Itanagar, Mumbai; Least safe cities: Patna, Jaipur, Faridabad, Delhi, Kolkata, Srinagar, Ranchi
facts.head: News

facts.text: 6 in 10 women felt safe; 40% not so safe/unsafe
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: Workplace: 91% feel safe; half unsure of POSH policies
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: Harassment 2024: 7% in public spaces; 14% for women under 24; hotspots — neighbourhoods 38%, public transport 29%
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: Reporting: only 1 in 3 report; 25% trust authorities
facts.head: Findings
